# S-001 — Checkout form

## Story
As **Maya the Maintainer** (P-001), I want a checkout form, so that guests can pay.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1: Given a filled form, when I submit it, then payment starts.
- [ ] AC-2: Given an empty form, when I submit it, then validation errors appear.

## Out of scope
- Saved payment methods
